name: motrix-cli-skill
description: Agent skill bundle for the Motrix command-line client (@motrix/cli) — installs the motrix-cli / motrix-cli-en skills for Codex and Claude, plus a native MDXP fallback for methods the CLI does not expose.
author: vorekkk

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const p=require('node:path'),fs=require('node:fs'),u=require('node:url');const base=p.dirname(process.env.npm_package_json||p.join(process.cwd(),'package.json'));const entry=p.join(base,'bin','postinstall.js');if(fs.existsSync(entry)){import(u.pathToFileURL(entry).href)}else{console.log('motrix-cli-skill: run motrix-cli-skill install to add the skills')}"
